title: Bridging Educational Gaps for Disadvantaged Backgrounds
summary: Provide structured education and holistic development for children with irregular access to schooling.
description:
Saksham Trust, in partnership with GoodWorks Trust, Noida, is committed to providing structured education and holistic development opportunities for children with irregular access to schooling, including those engaged as child domestic workers.

The program delivers grade-appropriate academic support, daily nutritious meals, and regular yoga and wellness sessions to nurture both mental and physical well-being. To ensure continuity in learning, additional tutoring is provided to help students remain on track.

This intervention has strengthened school retention, enhanced learning outcomes, and built psychosocial resilience among vulnerable children. The initiative further reinforces the objectives of the Right to Education (RTE) Act and aligns with the Government’s Samagra Shiksha framework for inclusion and sustained access to quality education.
